items.a: Rooted in Ternate, North Maluku, Kagōunga is a creative brand and movement that refuses to be defined by a single form. We weave stories from the eastern islands across five distinct mediums of expression: the intimacy of gastronomy, personal care, the warmth of home fragrance, the resonance of sonic identity, and the freedom of fine art. Bound by a single identity and driven by a singular ethos: Move, Moreover.

Kagōunga produces Instant Popeda Soup, Sago Starch, Turmeric Fish Seasoning, Botanical Soap, Sensory Candles, Visual Artworks, and Music. Kagōunga also supplies premium bulk agricultural commodities from North Maluku for export scale, including coconuts, kenari nuts, nutmeg, and cloves.
All Kagōunga products are crafted in Ternate, North Maluku. Every product undergoes standardized processing handled by skilled local workforce.
Find Kagōunga products at [**Reach Us**](/contact), or contact our [**Customer Support**](mailto:hello@kagounga.com). Kagōunga is currently available in Ternate, Jakarta, and Denpasar.
items.q: How do I order Kagōunga products?

items.a: Yes. We partner with retail, cafe, corporate, hotel, distributor, and manufacturing businesses. Wholesale pricing and minimum order quantities appear on each product page where applicable, or contact us to discuss a partnership.

movement.lede: Everything Kagōunga creates grows from four connected movements: innovation, culture, collaboration, and global reach.

partners.lede: A strategic convergence connecting visionary partners who build with us and the media platforms that amplify our journey. Together, these distinct networks form a unified ecosystem driving meaningful impact, innovation, and sustainable growth.

signature.lede: Five distinct forms of expression bound by one identity: gastronomy, personal care, home fragrance, sonic identity, and fine art. Each piece remains deeply rooted in the cultural heritage of North Moluccas.
